bio.text: Mayes Middleton is a Republican member of the Texas Senate for District 11, serving since 2023; the Senate's biography lists his earlier legislative service as a Texas House member from 2019 to 2022.
Middleton is the Republican nominee for Texas Attorney General in the November 3, 2026 general election, according to the Texas Tribune.
According to his Senate biography, Middleton is president of Middleton Oil Company and also runs ranching, cattle and farming operations.
The Senate biography lists a J.D. and a B.A. from the University of Texas at Austin and Galveston as his hometown.
